headline: Union of Ukrainian Entrepreneurs opposes idea of forming an insurance fund through tax increases
summary: The Union of Ukrainian Entrepreneurs supports a systematic mechanism for insuring war risks but opposes financing it through tax increases. It proposes offsetting documented war losses against future corporate income tax.
why: War-risk insurance and compensation affect business investment and reconstruction financing in Ukraine.
